title: Coherent exact sequence with strictly smaller reducible supports
statement: Let X be a Noetherian scheme, T a closed subset, and F a coherent module with support T. If T is not preirreducible, there is a monomorphism f:H → F with H and coker f coherent and each of their supports strictly contained in T. The canonical cokernel sequence is short exact. No filtration is asserted.

proof.text: Use the closed-union characterization of non-preirreducibility to find two closed sets covering T, neither containing T. Intersect each with T to obtain proper closed subsets T1 and T2 and support(F) = T1 union T2.

Construct K as the actual vanishing ideal of T1. Apply coherent_ideal_power_supported_on_closed with C = T2 to choose an exponent n, quasi-coherence of K^n, and support(K^n F) contained in T2. Define H = K^n F via the multiplication image and f its image inclusion.

Coherence of F gives quasi-coherence. Quasi-coherence is preserved by tensor products and images, so H is quasi-coherent. The coherent-submodule theorem gives coherence of H and its cokernel; the image inclusion is monic and its canonical cokernel sequence is short exact.

The ideal zero-set theorem identifies the proper-stalk locus of K with T1. Outside T1 its stalk inclusion is surjective, so the stalk ideal is the unit ideal. The product/quotient stalk formula gives a zero quotient stalk for every exponent n; at exponent zero use the identity inclusion. Thus support(cokernel f) is contained in T1. Compose both support bounds with the proper inclusions T1,T2 into T.

lean.statement:
theorem exists_coherent_submodule_of_reducible_support
    (X : Scheme.{u}) [IsNoetherian X]
    (T : TopologicalSpace.Closeds X)
    (F : X.Modules) (hF : RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace F)
    (hSupp : {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (F.presheaf.stalk x)} = (T : Set X))
    (hred : ¬ IsPreirreducible (T : Set X)) :
    ∃ (H : X.Modules) (f : H ⟶ F),
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace H ∧
      RingedSpace.IsCoherent X.toRingedSpace (cokernel f) ∧
      (ShortComplex.mk f (cokernel.π f) (cokernel.condition f)).ShortExact ∧
      {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton (H.presheaf.stalk x)} ⊂ (T : Set X) ∧
      {x : X | ¬ Subsingleton ((cokernel f).presheaf.stalk x)} ⊂ (T : Set X)
